summary: Code written into PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE memory, run, rewritten and run again (Sprint 065 item 9e). mono writes and patches its methods with plain stores and no FlushInstructionCache; a scratch frontier found 11,365 translated blocks whose guest bytes had changed by the stop. Each rewrite takes effect at the next call; a write to data on the code's page leaves the code as it is.
